calibration_role_intended: Cohort D vendor 2 (Skydio = independent-vendor for cross-source corroboration test, not within-vendor cross-product like Mavic+FPV)
p11_probe_method: curl probe of 6 candidate URLs + WebSearch for 'Skydio Pilot desktop application Windows macOS download'

probe_results.websearch_canonical_resource: https://www.skydio.com/software shows mobile + cloud + controller-firmware; no Windows/macOS desktop installer

substantive_finding: Skydio's product distribution model has no standalone desktop application. Operator-axis software is split across iOS/Android mobile apps (App Store / Google Play distribution), hardware-controller firmware (X10 Controller integrated OS), and cloud-only enterprise platforms (Skydio Cloud, Remote Flight Deck, DFR Command, Fleet Manager). No public 'Skydio Pilot' desktop installer exists.
cp17_thesis_implication: Second empirical data point for the CP17 desktop-axis thesis bifurcation: the operator-cohort desktop class has dissolved into mobile + web across drone-tooling vendors (Skydio confirms this; DJI partially confirms with the bootstrap-installer-that-downloads-app-bits-from-cloud pattern, though DJI retains a thin desktop wrapper). Cohort D yield is fundamentally limited by the absence of vendor-shipped desktop tooling at this layer of the modern drone software stack.
cohort_d_calibration_window_closure_reco: DJI Mavic + DJI FPV cross-product attestation (CP24 within-vendor) + Skydio documented_absence + H2 disambig via FileZilla control binary. Calibration window CLOSED on this record; freeze timestamp set in HANDOFF §9 close.
